local_inputs.role: Original AAT program and separate route evidence.
Historical physical-formulation challenge; conditional stock arithmetic is not a recovered recipe.
Historical mechanistic/comparator gate; current claim-specific interpretation narrows universal mechanism/washout requirements.
Previously recorded nominal/antigen discrepancy; retained without inventing loss mechanism.
Original independent marginal-dollar review, AAT blocks48–49 and rank/cost rows supplied to root review input. This external scratch path is provenance, not a repository dependency.

evidence_rows.observation: Vial content is functional A1PI defined by human-NE neutralization, distinct from total protein or antigen.
evidence_rows.limits: Actual labeled functional quantity is lot specific. This label is not a warm-circuit release assay.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Start from an existing manufactured article specification while separating delivered and retained active exposure.

evidence_rows.observation: Reconstitution introduces defined excipients; administration instructions have a three-hour room-temperature limit and no mixing with other medicinal products.
evidence_rows.limits: Neither sudden inactivation after three hours nor twelve-hour EVLP stability follows. Historical stock-contribution arithmetic is conditional, not the human recipe.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Qualify the actual process; do not dismiss the article or assume its compatibility from the clinical label.

evidence_rows.locator: STEEN IFU English product description and Additives
evidence_rows.observation: Base perfusate contains human serum albumin and dextran; replacement-fluid additives are part of the process.
evidence_rows.limits: Current document does not authenticate historical study lots or validate adding AAT. The base fluid already has physical preservation functions.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Compare final compositions and practical process burden; a saline control cannot alone isolate AAT-specific biology.

evidence_rows.observation: Pig study nominal AAT and measured human-AAT antigen differ without a reconciled explanation in the inspected text.
evidence_rows.electrolyte_direction: Sodium/chloride lower in treatment, calcium lower late; no potassium difference reported.
evidence_rows.limits: No inferred fractional adsorption, consumption, oxidation or analytical-recovery loss. No direct residual NE/PR3 activity supplied by antigen measurements.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: The informative task is reconciling relevant concentration/activity measurements, not copying a nominal literature dose.

evidence_rows.observation: Five paired human donors; nominal AAT versus saline, with differential replacement/dilution and antigen-based NE content.
evidence_rows.printed_circuit_volume: 1.5 mL, apparent error retained rather than operationally corrected
evidence_rows.limits: Physical matching unestablished. Control-only Steen replacement affects cytokine concentration interpretation. Do not assign this recipe or denominator to final eight-donor publication.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Preserve functionality observations without overclaiming causal molecular specificity or a validated exposure target.

evidence_rows.observation: Eight-donor thesis names Zemaira and describes fresh solution replacement during EVLP.
evidence_rows.limits: Version-specific primary thesis text; full final 2026 methods unavailable. Whole-lung stock reconstitution and fully matched placebo are not established.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Do not describe one initial addition as demonstrating twelve-hour unchanged-stock stability; account for replenishment in the product and cost question.

evidence_rows.observation: AAT-antigen and NE–AAT-complex ELISAs provide different information from remaining inhibitory activity. Nominal, expected and measured antigen values are not reconciled.
evidence_rows.limits: Do not silently resolve source conflicts, infer a clinical threshold from author supratherapeutic wording, or treat complexes as a direct free-active-AAT/PR3 assay. No new calculation or modeling.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Known interaction supports plausibility while active exposure and mass balance remain qualification questions.

evidence_rows.locator: Thesis §5.3.2 cell-culture AAT treatment, printed p. 134
evidence_rows.observation: Manufacturer-directed reconstitution is stated for the separate endothelial cell-culture subsection.
evidence_rows.limits: This sentence does not establish the whole-lung stock volume or physically matched EVLP control. Cell-culture pretreatment/removal is followed by AAT during cold and warm phases; it is not a drug-free whole-organ proof.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Avoid filling the remaining organ-formulation gap with a neighboring method.

evidence_rows.locator: Accepted manuscript Methods pp. 4–7; Figures 2–4 legends pp. 20–21
evidence_rows.observation: Independent cold-storage study uses recombinant rather than plasma-derived AAT.
evidence_rows.exact_article: HEK293-produced human M1(V213) AAT and A355D/I356P/P357D/M358S reactive-loop mutant
evidence_rows.species: C57BL/6J mice; WT donor to WT or Ela2/Prtn3-double-deficient recipient
evidence_rows.limits: Group range retained; no exact per-panel arm counts imputed. Microscope fields and biochemical replicates do not enlarge the transplant n.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Retain independent mechanistic/function support with its exact preparation, cold route and short interval.

evidence_rows.locator: Accepted manuscript Methods p. 5; Results p. 8; Figure 1
evidence_rows.observation: Grafts were rinsed with plain Perfadex before implantation; AAT remained detectable in graft tissue four hours after reperfusion.
evidence_rows.limits: Western blot establishes retained immunoreactive protein, not a quantitative active-tissue concentration, zero systemic carryover or long-term benefit.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Early benefit after a rinse supports local protection. Retained AAT can be useful and is not by itself a stop condition; drug-free repair needs separate proof.

evidence_rows.observation: Active AAT, noninhibitory mutant and recipient NE/PR3 double knockout provide convergent protease-related evidence.
evidence_rows.mutant_scope: Reactive-loop sequence changes also affect charge/conformation and potential membrane interaction.
evidence_rows.double_knockout_scope: Both enzymes removed together; does not identify each enzyme as individually necessary.
evidence_rows.limits: Not perfect one-property control; no proof of obligatory dual inhibition or superiority over an NE-selective comparator. No universal warm-human mechanism claim.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Measure activity appropriate to the proposed claim; mechanistic uniqueness is not a prerequisite to recognizing practical benefit.

evidence_rows.locator: Accepted manuscript main Methods/Discussion and caption inspection
evidence_rows.observation: Main text notes limited post-transplant hemodynamic monitoring; observation is early and graft/recipient context is isogenic.
evidence_rows.limits: False recovery flags mean unverified, not proved absent. No figure digitization, animal-level reanalysis or additional biological result.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Do not assign clinical durability or precise failure probabilities from this small acute study.

evidence_rows.observation: Sivelestat donor-flush rat transplantation provides direct organ-context rationale for the existing comparator.
evidence_rows.exact_article_freshly_recovered: sivelestat; prior Round4 fulltext specified sodium tetrahydrate
evidence_rows.result_scope: Higher-dose arm improved oxygenation, airway pressure, edema and MPO measures.
evidence_rows.limits: No direct AAT comparison; no established exact warm-human regimen or automatic clinical superiority. Fresh fulltext inaccessible.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: An appropriately scoped simpler-comparator question can test incremental product value without screening another opportunity.

evidence_rows.observation: Pig NE-inhibitor EVLP study reports during-EVLP functional benefits and a post-transplant PVR difference.
evidence_rows.reported_n_text: treated and control groups, respectively; n=6
evidence_rows.limits: Abstract does not name the inhibitor. Do not infer identity from cited literature or convert the post-transplant PVR result into verified oxygenation/durability benefit.
evidence_rows.decision_impact: Context for an existing comparator class, not AAT replication or a new candidate.

claims.claim: A manufactured starting article is identifiable; warm-process compatibility and retained active exposure remain separate.
The nominal-versus-antigen discrepancy remains unresolved; a specific loss mechanism cannot be assigned.
The newly recovered eight-donor thesis describes replenishment, not validated unchanged-stock twelve-hour stability.
Antigen, NE–AAT complexes and remaining NE/PR3 inhibitory capacity are not interchangeable.
Independent cold recombinant-AAT evidence supports early post-rinse protection without proving complete drug removal or the warm product.
Convergent protease evidence does not establish obligatory dual NE/PR3 action or a unique-mechanism commercial advantage.
Existing NE-inhibitor comparators have relevant evidence but no recovered AAT head-to-head or interchangeable warm-human recipe.
A finite preservation process can have value through useful graft outcomes even if physical formulation or retained local AAT contributes.

marginal_decision.original_priced_scope: Initial formulation/potency/process qualification only; scarce organs and transplant validation excluded.
marginal_decision.rank_scope: Inherited independent-review order, not a new all-portfolio ranking. Historical priority8/one planning point is separate.
marginal_decision.reason: Known starting product, human-organ signal and independent mechanistic evidence justify retaining an informative bounded qualification option, conditional on remaining cost, meaningful next decisions and retained value.
not_required_for_every_first_qualificati: Proof that both NE and PR3 are individually necessary
requires_for_claim_specific_interpretati: Appropriate actual article and process specification
Interpretable active exposure or relevant measurement needed by the decision
A practical incremental comparator for useful product benefit
A viable contribution and retained-value route

open_fields: Direct warm-process residual NE and PR3 inhibition where required for the claim
Validated aggregate/adsorption/compatibility and active mass balance
Quantitative tissue/recipient active exposure and clinically useful downstream outcome
Current scoped quotation, material/model access and value-capture feasibility
reopen_for: A named final-methods artifact changing process interpretation
Relevant direct activity or compatibility evidence
A concrete scoped cost/access fact affecting qualification value
do_not_reopen_for: A repeated dataset presented as new replication
A source mention without decision-changing detail
